rounds.fact: Twitter launched in 2006 and the 140-character limit came directly from SMS constraints, since early tweets were literally sent and received as text messages.
LinkedIn launched in 2003 out of a founder's living room. By 2005 it was already leaning into the dense, spreadsheet-like profile layout that professional networking sites still use.
Craigslist's design has barely changed since the 1990s, on purpose. The founder has said repeatedly that plain text links serve the function better than a redesign would.
Airbnb started in 2008 with the founders renting out air mattresses in their own apartment during a design conference, which is where the original name came from.
Instagram launched iPhone-only in late 2010 and hit 25,000 users on day one. Its web presence stayed minimal for years while the app itself was the whole product.
